directory_observation_contract.digest: SHA-256 of the encoded tuple array
directory_observation_contract.purpose: break self-reference for SOURCE_ROOT observation only; PAYLOAD_ROOT is fully enumerated and all entries remain visible to isolation checks
directory_observation_contract.stable_read: capture root identity before and after enumeration; reject any identity change or child tuple change
directory_observation_contract.symlink_policy: record symlinks as SYMLINK and never follow them
directory_observation_contract.tuple_encoding: sorted UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(,,:,) applied to the row array

commands.stdout: exactly HEAD SHA plus one LF
exactly local-ref target SHA plus one LF

git_probe_contract.local_presence_rule: The candidate object MUST be present in the selected repository object store; no fetch, alternates, promisor, worktree or external commondir is permitted.

independent_evidence_reachability.reason: No adapter in this v1 registry may promote evidence to INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED; that class requires a future externally provisioned launcher, sandbox, trust anchor and positive attested fixture.

predicate_registry_contract.nullability_rule: Explicit null is permitted only when the role declares nullable=true and null_means; null cannot satisfy unless success explicitly says so.
predicate_registry_contract.reason_order_rule: reason_order is descending first-match precedence; DECISION_SATISFIED is considered only after all required conditions pass.
predicate_registry_contract.record_success_rule: Every record role used to satisfy a v1 predicate requires effective_evidence_class=INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED; other classes are diagnostic only.
predicate_registry_contract.semantic_rule: A check is SATISFIED only when every listed success selector is present, type-valid, bound to the selected candidate/phase, and satisfies the listed operator and expected relation; authentication or digest validity alone is never sufficient.
predicate_registry_contract.duplicate_key_rule: Reject duplicate object keys before schema validation or canonicalization.
predicate_registry_contract.dependency_graph_rule: Reject unknown IDs, self-edges, duplicate edges and cycles before evaluating any predicate.
predicate_registry_contract.report_projection_rule: Every non-record selector used by a predicate MUST resolve to a closed report-schema property or a declared derived value.

trusted_launcher.interface: external provisioning contract in trusted execution profile; launcher must verify all identities and establish sandbox before exec
